c.tagline: Port wine, azulejos, and riverside romance.

emergency.note: 112 covers police, medical and fire; English-speaking operators are generally available.

avoid.reason: Pickpocketing around São Bento/Ribeira and on transit

hood_desc: Ribeira is the postcard-perfect riverfront old town with steep medieval lanes, colorful facades and the Douro at its feet; atmospheric and central but touristy, crowded and noisy, best for first-timers who want to be in the heart of the scenery.

Baixa is the bustling downtown around Aliados and Santa Catarina, packed with shops, cafes, transit links and nightlife; lively and supremely convenient, ideal for travelers who want everything walkable and do not mind urban energy.

Cedofeita is an arty, bohemian quarter along Rua de Miguel Bombarda full of galleries, indie boutiques, brunch spots and creative locals; relaxed and hip, suited to younger visitors and design lovers who prefer a local, less-touristy feel.

Bonfim is a gritty, rapidly gentrifying residential district east of the center, with authentic tascas, craft breweries and a real neighborhood rhythm; great value and increasingly trendy, best for those seeking everyday local life over polish.

Foz do Douro is the affluent seaside neighborhood where the river meets the Atlantic, known for its promenade, beaches, breezy restaurants and elegant homes; calm and upscale but away from the historic core, ideal for a quieter, refined stay.

water.note: Tap water meets EU standards and is safe to drink, though many locals prefer bottled for taste.

transit.pay: Buy an Andante card (about €0.60, ~$0.65) at metro stations or Loja Andante shops, then load zone-based tickets from about €1.40 (~$1.50) or a 24-hour pass from €5.15 (~$5.50); a 1-day Andante Tour tourist pass costs about €7.50 (~$8). Contactless bank-card tap-in is being rolled out but not yet universal, so the card is the safe default.
transit.hours: The Metro runs daily from about 6am to 1am, with slightly reduced Sunday hours.

transit.m: Metro Line E (Purple/Violet) from airport to Trindade, ~35 min
STCP bus 601 to city center, ~40 min
